interventions.first_login: Welcome. We can start with an account to analyse, a portfolio to import, or a tour of the demo — your call.
interventions.esn_profile_incomplete: Your ESN profile is still incomplete. Without it, what I prepare stays generic: the same arguments for every account.
interventions.no_connector: No tool is connected yet. Connect your calendar and inbox and I'll prep your meetings every morning.
interventions.first_account_ready: Your first account file is ready. The Action plan tab is where you read what to do, and in what order.
interventions.no_action_validated: Your first analysis is ready and no action has been validated yet. Shall we go through them one by one?
interventions.first_action_validated: First action validated. That's the rhythm from here: I prepare, you review, and nothing goes out without your say-so.
interventions.week_one_recap: You've been here a week, and there's already something to look back on: what was prepared, what moved on your accounts.
interventions.empty_talent_pool: Your talent pool is empty, so I can't suggest anyone. Do you have a consultant file somewhere?
interventions.placed_roles_unknown: I don’t know yet which roles you place, and nothing in your context lets me infer it. Will you tell me? Your hiring signals will follow your roles.
interventions.needs_without_matching: You have open needs and no shortlist. Matching compares your talent pool against the most urgent one.
interventions.crm_not_connected: You've been analysing accounts for a while and your CRM still isn't connected. Once it is, prepared tasks are written there after you approve them.
interventions.no_routine_enabled: No routine is enabled. Three of them cover the essentials of what happens while you're away.
interventions.copilot_never_used: You've never asked me anything yet. There's a library of ready-made questions if you want to see what I can do.
interventions.missions_without_timesheet: Missions are recorded, but no timesheets. That's what's missing before invoicing can be ready.
interventions.no_skills_dossier: Your consultants are in the pool, but no skills dossier has come out of it yet. One is generated from a profile.
interventions.plan_feature_never_opened: Your workspace still holds very little: few kinds of object have been created. Your plan covers more — worth seeing which ones before you renew.
interventions.no_connection_7_days: Good to have you back — you hadn't dropped in for over a week. I've gathered what moved on your accounts in the meantime.
interventions.connector_error_48h: One of your connections has stopped responding. Some automations are paused until it's restored.
interventions.credits_expiring: You still have room this month. Want to analyse a few accounts?
interventions.notifications_all_off: All your notifications are off: nothing reaches you any more, not even a broken connection. A daily cap would be less drastic.
interventions.high_correction_rate: You keep correcting the same field by hand. A human correction is final: I never overwrite it, not even with fresher data.
interventions.single_active_seat: You're the only one using {{brand}} on the seats you pay for. I'm preparing a starting point for your team.
interventions.no_action_14_days: You haven't validated anything for two weeks. Am I preparing things that aren't useful? Tell me and I'll adjust.
interventions.trial_ending: Your trial ends soon. Worth deciding with the facts in hand: what has been used, and what each plan covers.
interventions.mission_ending_no_plan: A mission is coming to an end and no renewal is open on that account. Client feedback is asked for before the end, not after.
interventions.consultant_free_soon: A consultant frees up within thirty days, and needs are still open. Comparing their profile will show which ones hold up.
interventions.availability_stale: Some declared availabilities haven't been revalidated in over sixty days. Until they are confirmed, I no longer present them as certain.
interventions.client_dependency: A single client carries more than a third of the daily revenue of ongoing missions. If it scales down or leaves, your business moves with it — better to know now and see who else could weigh in.
interventions.accounts_without_owner: Active accounts have no owner. Without one, nobody holds the next action — assign them before they go cold.
interventions.account_collisions: Several people are acting on the same accounts. One of them should carry the next action; the others contribute.
interventions.portfolio_too_wide: Your active portfolio is above fifty accounts. Beyond that you skim — pick the ones you really work this week.
interventions.consultant_to_requalify: Some talent-pool profiles have no declared availability. Until someone states it, I present them neither as free nor as busy.
interventions.follow_up_overdue: Some account follow-ups are past their due date. Picking them up now keeps an account from going cold without anyone having decided it.
interventions.calls_without_debrief: Some recent calls were logged without a debrief. Without it, what was said stays in your head and nowhere else.
interventions.interview_brief_not_consulted: An interview is coming up and its brief hasn't been opened yet. Objective, pitch, ready questions: it's all there, just not read yet.
interventions.forecast_revenue_declared_blocked: Some running missions have a blocked renewal or are at risk. That revenue is declared in difficulty: the forecast removes it from its low scenario.
interventions.accounts_without_next_action: Some accounts have no next action planned. That's how an account slips away unnoticed.
interventions.margin_not_measured: No active mission carries its loaded cost. Without it, margin isn't computed: it stays unknown, not zero.
interventions.mission_ended_without_feedback: A mission ended more than two weeks ago with no feedback collected. A reference you don't ask for doesn't come back later.
interventions.rfp_deadline_gaps: A tender is due within three days and mandatory requirements have no validated answer. Now is the time to look, not the night before.
interventions.long_bench: A consultant has been on the bench for more than thirty days. The open needs may have nothing for them — we'll only know by looking.
interventions.need_open_without_shortlist: A need has been open for more than five days and nobody has been put forward on it yet. Five days is how long a client takes to ask elsewhere.
interventions.timesheet_missing_after_reminders: A timesheet still hasn't come in after two reminders. While it's missing, the month it covers cannot be invoiced.
interventions.payment_overdue_30_days: An invoice is more than thirty days past its due date and nothing has come in. Invoices with no due date are not counted: without one, there is no lateness to measure.
interventions.pipeline_runs_dry: Nothing in your pipeline is expected to close beyond two months. What signs in two months gets opened now, not in two months.
interventions.consultant_repeat_placement: One of your consultants has started three missions at the same client. At that point it is no longer extra hands: it is a door to a wider engagement.
interventions.account_hiring_with_available_bench: This account is hiring, and someone in your talent pool is free. That is the window where extra hands get accepted without a tender.
interventions.mission_active_past_end_date: A mission is marked as running while the end date on file has already passed. Both cannot be true: one of the two has to be settled.
interventions.mission_start_not_ready: A mission starts within two weeks and its start checklist is not complete. Here is what is still missing — nothing goes out without you.
interventions.mission_day_one_unconfirmed: A mission’s start date has arrived and it is not marked as running yet. The consultant’s arrival needs confirming — I won’t chase anyone on your behalf.
interventions.account_pain_with_dated_signal: This account carries a qualified pain point, backed by a dated signal that is still current. It is a hypothesis to test, not a fact: I show you what it rests on.
